newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Iraq aims to reach 1990 output soon as possible.
newsitem.headline: Iraq aims to reach 1990 output soon as possible.

text.p: Head of the Iraqi OPEC delegation Osama al-Hiti said Iraq aims to return to 1990 production levels as soon as possible but was unable to say when this would be.
"When we are back in the market and the situation allows it we will try to increase our production to the status of 1990", he told reporters.
Asked if Iraq would be seeking a higher allocation at OPEC's June meeting, he said " if everything goes according to plan...we will be hoping for a better participation of the market."
He added that there was support from other OPEC members for higher Iraqi oil output.
"We used to produce over three million barrels per day and (other OPEC members) fully agree we should get back to our original status as soon as possible."

He reiterated that he hoped Iraq would be exporting oil before the end of this year and said he was optimistic that the U.N. would later allow it to export more crude under the proposed oil-for-food deal.
